# BlaC Documentation

Type-safe state management for React with automatic re-render optimization. Comprehensive guide covering core concepts, React integration, plugins, testing, and framework integrations.

## Guide

- [What is BlaC?](/guide/introduction): Overview of BlaC architecture and philosophy.
- [Quick Start](/guide/getting-started): Set up your first BlaC project in minutes.
- [Core Concepts](/guide/concepts): Understand Cubits, state, emissions, and reactivity.
- [Mental Model](/guide/mental-model): Visual and conceptual foundations of BlaC.
- [Passing Inputs](/guide/inputs): Constructor args, external data, and decoupled inputs.
- [Async](/guide/async): Handling promises, side effects, and async state transitions.
- [TypeScript](/guide/typescript): Type inference, generic Cubits, and utility types.
- [Patterns & Recipes](/guide/patterns): Common patterns, composition, and advanced techniques.
- [Best Practices](/guide/best-practices): Guidelines for maintainability and performance.
- [Debounce](/guide/recipes/debounce): Debounced state updates with cancelation.
- [Form Validation](/guide/recipes/form-validation): Async validation, error display, and submission.
- [Optimistic Update](/guide/recipes/optimistic-update): Immediate feedback with server reconciliation.
- [Pagination](/guide/recipes/pagination): Cursor-based and offset-based pagination patterns.
- [Reset to Initial State](/guide/recipes/reset-to-initial): Clearing and resetting state.
- [Undo / Redo](/guide/recipes/undo-redo): History stack and time-travel debugging.
- [WebSocket Subscription](/guide/recipes/websocket): Real-time updates and message handling.
- [Comparison](/guide/comparison): BlaC vs Redux, Zustand, Flutter Bloc, and MobX.
- [Troubleshooting & FAQ](/guide/troubleshooting): Solutions to common issues and gotchas.
- [Glossary](/guide/glossary): Term definitions and jargon reference.
- [Migrating from v1](/guide/migration-from-v1): Upgrade guide from BlaC v1 to v2.
- [Versioning & Stability](/guide/versioning): Semantic versioning and stability guarantees.
- [Changelog](/guide/changelog): Release notes and feature history.
- [End-to-end Tutorial](/guide/tutorial): Comprehensive walkthrough building a complete app.
- [How BlaC works internally](/guide/internals): Reactivity engine, tracking, and staged rebuild.

## Core

- [Cubit](/core/cubit): The core state container class — emit, state, and lifecycle.
- [Tracking](/core/tracked): Fine-grained reactivity, tracked properties, and computed selectors.
- [Configuration](/core/configuration): Instance config, keepAlive, excludeFromDevTools, circuit breakers.
- [Instance Management](/core/instance-management): Singletons, per-component instances, and the InstanceManager.
- [System Events](/core/system-events): onSystemEvent lifecycle hooks — stateChanged, dispose.
- [Bloc Communication](/core/bloc-communication): Cross-bloc dependencies via this.depend().
- [watch](/core/watch): Observing Cubit state outside React.
- [Low-level subscribe](/core/subscribe): Raw subscription API for advanced use cases.
- [Authoring Plugins](/core/plugins): Plugin hook system, configuration, and composable extensions.
- [Types](/core/types): Complete TypeScript API reference — types and interfaces.

## React

- [Getting Started](/react/getting-started): useBloc hook setup and basic usage patterns.
- [useBloc](/react/use-bloc): Hook signature, options (args, select, onMount, onUnmount), and re-render control.
- [Dependency Tracking](/react/dependency-tracking): Per-consumer proxies, re-render isolation, and dependency injection.
- [Performance](/react/performance): Profiling, optimization strategies, and avoiding re-renders.
- [Preact](/react/preact): Using BlaC with Preact for lightweight apps.

## Plugins

- [Overview](/plugins/overview): Plugin architecture, load order, and lifecycle.
- [Logging](/plugins/logging): Debug logging plugin with structured output.
- [DevTools](/plugins/devtools): Time-travel debugging and state inspector for Chrome DevTools.
- [Persistence](/plugins/persistence): LocalStorage and IndexedDB adapters.

## Testing

- [Overview](/testing/overview): Testing strategy, setup, and best practices.
- [Core Testing API](/testing/core): Testing Cubits in isolation — state, emissions, and async.
- [React Testing](/testing/react): Testing hooks, component integration, and user interactions.

## Integrations

- [SSR & per-request isolation](/integrations/ssr): Server-side rendering, request-scoped instances, and hydration.
- [Next.js](/integrations/nextjs): App Router, Pages Router, RSC considerations, and store placement.
- [Remix](/integrations/remix): Loader data seeding, server/client snapshot matching, and transitions.
- [React Native](/integrations/react-native): AsyncStorage adapter, mobile considerations, and patterns.
- [Outside React](/integrations/outside-react): watch, vanilla JS, Node.js, and non-React contexts.

## DirtyTalk

- [DirtyTalk Overview](/dirtytalk/): Structured reactivity engine and semantic dependency analysis.
- [Engine Getting Started](/dirtytalk/engine/getting-started): Core concepts and basic usage.
- [Engine Concepts](/dirtytalk/engine/concepts): Paths, skeleton, subscribers, and propagation.
- [Engine API Reference](/dirtytalk/engine/api-reference): Complete API for the engine subsystem.
- [Spatial Getting Started](/dirtytalk/spatial/getting-started): Geospatial data handling.
- [Spatial Concepts](/dirtytalk/spatial/concepts): Spatial data structures and operations.
- [Spatial API Reference](/dirtytalk/spatial/api-reference): Spatial API reference.
- [Structural Getting Started](/dirtytalk/structural/getting-started): Structural dependency analysis.
- [Structural Concepts](/dirtytalk/structural/concepts): AST traversal and semantic analysis.
- [Structural API Reference](/dirtytalk/structural/api-reference): Structural API reference.
